# HexField | 十六进制输入框 示例

## Example: Basic HexField

```json
{
  "state": {
    "hexValue": "52,61,72,21,1a,74,0,cf"
  },
  "rootId": "hexFieldBasic",
  "elements": [
    {
      "id": "hexFieldBasic",
      "component": "HexField",
      "props": {
        "value": { "path": "/hexValue" },
        "placeholder": "请输入十六进制数据"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```
